_about: Backlot Cinema Studio (Oct 20 2026). Pickers that compose one MiniMax H3 prompt in the model's own three-field, multi-shot format ([Shot N] + cut times). Every option maps to a prompt fragment in our own words. Pacing = a cut list as fractions of the clip; the shot ladder gives each cut a framing and a camera move written in H3's motion vocabulary (push in, arc shot, tracking shot, static shot...).

genre.name: General
genre.look: clean cinematic grade, balanced contrast, natural color

genre.name: Epic
genre.look: grand scale, sweeping compositions, rich saturated color, deep shadows and bright highlights
genre.music: a slow-building orchestral score with low strings and distant brass, swelling toward the end
genre.sound: wide open-air ambience, wind, distant echoes

genre.name: Drama
genre.look: restrained grade, soft contrast, muted warm palette, intimate framing
genre.music: a sparse piano theme, quiet and unhurried
genre.sound: quiet room tone, small intimate sounds of movement and breath

genre.name: Noir
genre.look: high-contrast black and white with deep blacks, hard shadows, venetian-blind light, cigarette haze
genre.music: a lonely muted trumpet over a slow upright bass
genre.sound: rain on glass, distant traffic, a ticking clock

genre.name: Comedy
genre.look: bright, evenly lit, punchy saturated color, wide flat compositions that leave room for the gag
genre.music: a light bouncy ukulele and pizzicato strings
genre.sound: lively everyday ambience, clear foley on every action

genre.name: Horror
genre.look: desaturated cold palette, crushed shadows, sickly green and amber practicals, unsettling negative space
genre.music: a low sustained drone with rare sharp string stabs
genre.sound: near silence broken by creaks, drips and a faint rising hum

genre.name: Action
genre.look: teal and orange grade, hard directional light, motion blur on fast movement, gritty texture
genre.music: driving percussive electronic score with a pulsing low end
genre.sound: impacts, engines, crowd and wind, every hit lands with weight

wide.motion: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

medium.motion: The camera holds a steady shot with a slight slow push in.

close.motion: The camera holds a static shot.

ecu.motion: The camera holds a static shot.

detail.motion: The camera tracks slowly across the detail.

ots.motion: The camera arcs slowly around the subject.

low.motion: The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed.

whip.frame: a fast whip-pan to a new angle
whip.motion: The camera pans right with large amplitude at fast speed, then settles.
